description: data/fonts/font_manifest.json (UH-Font-A): every custom .ttf/.otf a designer has imported through the editor's Theme panel, keyed by a generated font id. Pairs with data/fonts/imported/ (committed content, mirroring data/sprites/imported/*.png's D-31 precedent). Written ONLY by editor.font_import.import_font_file, through the validating writer. data/ui/active_font.json points at ONE entry here (or 'default' for the plain SysFont fallback) - the cross-file reference a schema can't express, so game/main.py's boot loader cross-checks it and fails loud (D-2), the same pattern engine.tilemap.load_map uses for checks schemas can't express.

entries.description: One entry per imported font, keyed by font id.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the editor's Font Family combo.

file.description: Font file path relative to data/fonts, resolved as a real path (mirrors asset_manifest.json's sheet field) - always imported/<font_id>.<ttf|otf>.

version.description: Font manifest format version; this schema is v1.

title: font_manifest
